body:
### Welcome to the Indian Hills Neighborhood Association, Lawrence Kansas
We are the first neighborhood association in Lawrence Kansas. 

* Read more about the Lawrence Neighborhood Associations : http://acornwebworks.com/LAN/links.html

## Meetings

* October 6, 2026 agenda: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1c7seto5t9hvU2FK7axLrA8xkbg_AAOGD/edit

## Board Nominations

* Nominate yourself or a neighbor by November 1, 2026: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSekO9jkQVd8Qka-KB7tU_N5vrhN8577V9pUdxQyS_UW3xB75g/viewform
* Voting runs November 3 through November 10, 2026.

## Social Media

* Our Facebook page is here https://www.facebook.com/pages/Indian-Hills-Neighborhood-Association/394091310635729
* Our Twitter : https://twitter.com/IndianaHillsNA

## Mailing List (ListServ)

Receive notices from the Indian Hills Neighborhood Association.

* Join the mailing list: https://groups.google.com/g/indianhillslawrence
* A Google Account is required to join. It doesn't have to be a Gmail address.
